351731.custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar and click Advisor Analysis in the left menu.
  2. Read the months along the bottom of the chart and the legend.
  3. Change the Date control to Last year.
  4. Read the months along the bottom of the chart.
  5. In the Advisor filter choose one advisor (any advisor in the list).
  6. Read the chart's legend and lines.
  7. Click Technician Utilization in the left menu.
  8. In the Technician filter keep one technician (any technician in the list) and read the chart.
  9. Click Technician Efficiency and change its Date control to Last quarter, then read the chart's dates.

351733.custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar and click Sales in the left menu.
  2. Click Hide chart at the right of the toolbar.
  3. Click Advisor Analysis in the left menu and leave its chart shown.
  4. Click Work Orders in the top bar.
  5. Click Reports and open Sales again.
  6. Click Advisor Analysis in the left menu again.
  7. Sign out, sign back in and open Sales again.
